title: With Aaron Donald mystique looming, Myles Garrett opens up on Rams' reality

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: With Aaron Donald mystique looming, Myles Garrett opens up on Rams' reality
sources.description: "The fact that my addition to the Rams made him want to get off the couch makes me think that he was always looking for a reason to get up — he just needed that spark," Garrett said.
